source.Name: Total population
source.Summary: Population: Total population and distribution by age and sex estimated to be  consistent with the population by age and sex of the (a) 1950, 1960, 1965,  1970, 1991 censuses; (b) population register through 2017; (c) official  estimates through 2017; (d) only total population for 1955, 1981, 2001,  2011 censuses; and with estimates of the subsequent trends in fertility,  mortality and international migration.

source.Name: Total fertility rate
source.Summary: Fertility: Total fertility rate and age pattern of fertility based on: registered  births classified by age of mother and the underlying female population by  age through 2017.  In addition, the official estimates of age-specific  fertility rates through 2016 have been considered.

source.Name: Life expectancy at birth
source.Summary: Overall Mortality: Life expectancy at birth and age pattern of mortality based on: (a)  official estimates through 2016; (b) registered deaths by age and sex  available through 2016; (c) International estimates used up to 2017.

source.Name: Infant/child mortality
source.Summary: Child Mortality: Under-five mortality based on: (a) official estimates of infant and child  mortality through 2016; (b) registered infant and child deaths through 2016.

source.Name: International migration
source.Summary: Migration: International migration based on: estimates derived as the differences  between overall population growth and natural increase.
